name: CineCMRQCExtension
highlights: Only the active physician-selected series remains resident in memory
Stale segmentation proxies and display nodes are force-hidden to prevent cross-series overlays
Saved unchanged series can be revisited without another save prompt
Incremental edited-frame tracking keeps mouse-wheel navigation responsive
Whole-patient export processes series sequentially to limit peak memory
The persistent Data Probe panel is collapsed by default to preserve module-panel space
